newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares slip on temporary blip.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares slip on temporary blip.

text.p: Austrian shares ended 0.32 percent down in aimless trade on Monday and market participants said they expected prices to consolidate at current levels before launching a fresh assault on the upside.

The ATX index of 21 blue-chip shares closed 3.75 points down at 1,175.21 with six issues higher, 14 lower and three unchanged. February ATX futures stood 3.6 points down at 1,181.4 on turnover of 536 contracts.
"Apart from a bit of profit-taking it was a pretty uneventful day," said one trader, pinpointing oil group OMV and steel firm VA Stahl as the main sell targets.
"The market might lose another couple of points before it tries for the 1,200 points level again," said a second, adding there was little likelihood of a test of support at 1,160.
Wolford, maker of slinky stockings, was the day's leading decliner. Its shares closed 34 schillings, or 2.34 percent, down at 1,421.
VA Stahl eased 3.7 schillings to 415.3 on 63,839 contracts. OMV fell 12.10 schillings to 1,326 on 26,666 contracts.
ATX heavyweight EA-Generali was the biggest gainer, rising 32 schillings, or 2.54 percent, to 1,294.
The broad-based Vienna bourse index closed 0.94 points down at 439.7.
